explanation: It is 0 at D1 and GO, and 0 at D2 whenever the agent chose a2 (whichever state it reached); it only turns on at D2 after an a1 choice, about 9-10 when a1 led to S1 (common) and the previous trial or two were rewarded, about 7-8 when the previous trial was unrewarded, and about 3-6 when a1 led to S2 (rare), lowest after an unrewarded trial. It runs weaker early (trials 1-5, about 6-8) and late in the episode (trials 75 and later, about 4-7 for common, 0-2 for rare), and is strongest in the middle of the episode, around trials 30-60.
